jd_summary: Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining Python applications and scripts. Support the development of backend services, REST APIs, and web applications using frameworks such as Django or Flask.
responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain Python applications and scripts.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented Python code following best practices.
Support the development of backend services, REST APIs, and web applications using frameworks such as Django or Flask.
Work with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB to store, retrieve, and manage data.
